producer_checks.information_cutoff: 2026-10-24; historical primary texts, dated corporate/government records and cited scholarship, including 2026 sources.
producer_checks.research_depth: At least 2,100 substantive words per locale, ten or more references, 2 parallel charts, flow, map, 2 tables and 11+ analytical headings. Requires independent factual/editorial QA.
producer_checks.translation_parity: Matching referenced URLs, chronology, quantitative chart series and main argument in English and Brazilian Portuguese, subject to separate QA.
producer_checks.source_check: Bibliographies include named books and papers, primary authors, public corporate/government filings and independent historical reporting; verify URL and claim-level fit at independent QA.
producer_checks.visual_signature: Two bilingual-identical numerical bar charts plus causal flow, geographical exposure map and comparative tables.
producer_checks.methodology: Distinguish documented interaction from thematic similarity, attribution from proof, government procurement from corporate revenue, normative ideology from technical performance.
